abstract_sentences.text: The probabilistic diffusion model (DM), generating content by inferencing through a recursive chain structure, has emerged as a powerful framework for visual generation.
After pre-training on enormous data, the model needs to be properly aligned to meet requirements for downstream applications.
How to efficiently align the foundation DM is a crucial task.
Contemporary methods are either based on Reinforcement Learning (RL) or truncated Backpropagation (BP).
However, RL and truncated BP suffer from low sample efficiency and biased gradient estimation, respectively, resulting in limited improvement or, even worse, complete training failure.
To overcome the challenges, we propose the Recursive Likelihood Ratio (RLR) optimizer, a Half-Order (HO) fine-tuning paradigm for DM.
The HO gradient estimator enables the computation graph rearrangement within the recursive diffusive chain, making the RLR’s gradient estimator an unbiased one with lower variance than other methods.
We characterize the bias, variance, and convergence behavior of our method.
Extensive experiments are conducted on image and video generation to validate the superiority of the RLR.
Furthermore, we propose a novel prompting technique that is natural for the RLR to achieve a synergistic effect.
The implementation is available at https://github.com/RTkenny/RLR-Optimizer.

final_judgment.single_storyline: 以 FO/HO/ZO 重排 diffusion recursive chain，在预算内保留局部 pathwise 多尺度信息并用 ZO 补全全链；理论与图像/视频结果沿同一链条回收（p.2–9）。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留公式 (1)–(10)、Figure 3/4/5、Table 1–5、主任务结果和理论命题条件（p.3–9）。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 证明、假设、完整 16 维 VBench、h 扫描、memory/time、solver、超参、prompt 与定性样例移至 Appendix A–J；seed、完整 budget 和原始曲线仍缺失（p.15–27）。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 3 画 truncated-BP collapse，Figure 4 画三段 RLR graph；Table 2/3/4/5 承担主结果、跨任务、DCoT 和组件决策，附录表补成本与完整维度（p.2–8、p.21–23）。
final_judgment.largest_gap: 低方差贯穿摘要、理论和 sample-efficiency，却没有直接 estimator variance、重复运行或不确定性；p.7 AQ “large margin”、Eq.(6) h/index、Eq.(8)/Eq.(19) V 记号增加核对成本（p.5–7、p.26–27）。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 计算图重排类方法应把局部段的 bias/variance 机制、预算代价和可证伪组件 ablation 放在同一证据链，并保留关键组件维度。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 适用于有递归链、可做局部 path differentiation 且预算受限的生成/序列优化；LR 假设、尺度结构或组件维度冲突时不可外推一般保证（p.6、p.8–9、p.24–27）。
